messages:
Ava: Rainy day idea — foam art face-off in the kitchen at 3pm? winner gets the last biscotti + eternal bragging rights :trophy:
Jamal: I'm in. my cat foam has been training for this :cat: 
Priya: I can do spirals and one questionable heart. still counts?
Noah: I'll livestream the judging. low production value but maximum drama. @GIF-bot drop a slow-clap gif
GIF-bot: <gif:slow-clap.gif>
Liz: Rules? time limit? weaponized cinnamon? :grimacing:
Kevin: Proposal: 30s pour, no stencils, one optional sprinkle. judge = Liz? :thinking_face:
Ava: Rules: 1) single pour 2) no stencils 3) one tiny sprinkle allowed 4) bonus for a punny foam caption
Priya: Caption entry: "Deja-brew" :coffee: 
Jamal: Caption: "Milk it for all it's worth" :joy: 
Noah: Voting plan: react with :1st_place_medal: for winner, :2nd_place_medal: for runner-up. I'll tally
Liz: I'll judge but full disclosure: biased toward animal motifs. no refunds.
Ava: Quick poll: react :coffee: to enter, :raised_hand: to judge, :thumbsup: to watch
Kevin: :coffee:
Priya: :coffee:
Jamal: :coffee:
Liz: :raised_hand:
Noah: :thumbsup:
Ava: Prize = last biscotti in the tin (clearly labeled CHAMP) + a ceremonious photo on the fridge
Priya: I'll bring a tiny spoon and my A-game. also maybe a towel
Jamal: See you at 3. may the foamiest win. :sunglasses:
Ava: If the rain gets worse we'll move to "scone consolation" at 4pm. low stakes, high crumbs.
